HI, I'M
MAHBUBUR.

I'm Mahbubur Rahman — a Computer Science & Engineering student at Islamic University, Bangladesh, currently in my second year. I'm based in Dhaka and originally from a small town near Mymensingh.

Alongside my coursework, I am interested in Research Assistant roles helping faculty clean and visualise survey data, and I want to freelance part-time as a junior data & web developer — building small pipelines, dashboards and websites for local businesses and fellow students.

I taught myself to code in high school, starting with simple HTML pages, and I've since picked up Python, SQL and the basics of cloud platforms through self-study, online courses, and a lot of trial and error. I'm not a senior engineer yet — I'm a student who genuinely loves building things and is in a hurry to learn everything I can.

🎓 Currently pursuing B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering at Islamic University, Bangladesh (2024 – present)
🔬 Interested in Research Assistant roles — supporting faculty with data collection, cleaning, and visualisation
💻 Self-taught in Python, SQL, HTML/CSS/JS, and exploring cloud platforms (AWS, GCP)
🌱 Actively learning data engineering fundamentals through courses, books, and personal projects
📸 Outside of tech: photography, writing, and following Bangladeshi tech & startup news
